query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name as productName,
  p.avgCost as avgCostAfter,
  poi.quantity,
  poi.unitCost as originalUnitCost,
  ROUND(poi.unitCost * 1.027462, 4) as adjustedUnitCost
FROM purchaseOrderItems poi
LEFT JOIN products p ON poi.productId = p.id
WHERE poi.purchaseOrderId = 2490001
ORDER BY poi.id
LIMIT 5
